title: German Stir-Fried Schnitzel
description: A classic German dish with a twist, this schnitzel recipe combines the traditional flavors of Germany with the quick and easy stir-fry technique.

ingredients.name: veal schnitzel
ingredients.notes: pork or chicken can be substituted

instructions: 1. Season the schnitzel with salt, pepper and egyptian cumin.
2. In a large skillet, heat the stir-fry oil over medium-high heat.
3. Fry the schnitzel until golden brown and cook through.
4. In a separate pan, stir-fry the onions and bell peppers until tender.
5. Add the velvety balsamic glaze to the pan and stir to combine.
6. Serve the schnitzel with the stir-fried vegetables and citrus zest.
7. Garnish with fresh parsley if desired.
